name: Ore no Shitsukekata
source:
The Student Executive Club has had enough of bad girls with their bad attitudes!
As head of the club I propose we literally f*ck some respect into them.
The stress of being a good student has us wound up so tight we could go forever.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ107807.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
学生行政俱乐部已经受够了态度恶劣的坏女孩了！
作为俱乐部的负责人，我建议我们对他们给予一些尊重。
成为一名好学生的压力让我们变得如此紧张，以至于我们可以永远走下去。
